prompts.image3d: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE landscape 3:2 high-end feature-film CGI CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET for BAOLA / 豹拉. Exactly three complete full-body views arranged left to right FRONT, strict LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, BACK, same character scale, head height and floor baseline, generous margins, no labels or borders. Image 1 is USER-APPROVED PRIMARY authority for exact CGI facial identity, realistic leopard head, golden eyes, golden tawny rosette fur, white muzzle, rounded ears, mature masculine slim strong tall proportions, precise suit tailoring, accessories and material quality. Image 2 is only supporting authority for side/back garment construction, tail anatomy and three-view arrangement; do NOT copy its drawing style or override Image 1's identity and rendered proportions. Preserve black/charcoal fine pinstripe THREE-PIECE suit, buttoned matching waistcoat, ivory shirt, burgundy necktie, ivory pocket square on character's left chest, gold pocket-watch chain across front waistcoat, black oxford shoes. Same dignified straight posture, BOTH hands naturally inside trouser pockets in all three angles, anatomically complete arms and wrists, do not invent exposed hands. Full ears, feet, both trouser legs and one complete long leopard tail per view. Tail emerges naturally at base of spine through rear clothing, hangs behind legs and curves gently without coils; side/back views clearly show its attachment and full tip. Correct rear suit structure, no tie or watch chain printed on back. Retain natural leopard face, not human, tiger or cheetah; no mane, crown, extra jewelry or props. Neutral warm grey seamless studio background, believable contact shadows beneath shoes. High-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved short fur and whiskers, crisp wool weave and fine vertical pinstripes, restrained silk tie sheen, distinct aged gold and polished leather response. Soft warm key and subtle cool fill, readable dark fabric, controlled highlights, all three full figures sharply resolved, no excessive depth blur. This is a coherent three-view model reference sheet, not narrative panels. No text, watermark, collage borders, plastic toy, drawing outlines, paper texture, painterly smears, extra limbs, missing legs, cropped tail or shoes. Match Image 1 faithfully rather than redesigning.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone full-body frontal 3D character portrait of BAOLA / 豹拉, the institutional-capital representative in animal financial fable AstralPact. Image 1 is authoritative for EXACT original character species, masculine adult identity, leopard head proportions, coat pattern, slim strong adult frame, suit and accessories. Image 2 is ONLY feature-film CGI quality/material and lighting reference, never copy dragon horns, hair, royal ornaments or female costume.
Subject: adult male anthropomorphic LEOPARD, mature roughly 40s direction, golden tawny short fur with natural black rosettes, white muzzle and chin, small rounded feline ears, natural black nose and whiskers, sharp amber eyes. Maintain a true elegant leopard head, NOT a human face, NOT a tiger or cheetah. Hands and tail carry matching leopard markings. Tall composed athletic but not bulky, understated financial executive. Calm assessing gaze, relaxed closed mouth, a slight reserved knowing expression rather than a villain grin.
Exact wardrobe from original: tailored black/charcoal fine PINSTRIPE THREE-PIECE SUIT, matching buttoned waistcoat and trousers, ivory white shirt, muted burgundy long necktie, small folded ivory pocket square, a single tasteful gold pocket-watch chain across waistcoat, black leather oxford shoes. Fine suit tailoring, structured shoulders, balanced lapels, clean cuff edges. Fur rosettes and fabric pinstripes are separate material patterns, never print leopard spots on suit. Both hands naturally in trouser pockets like original, not missing arms. Long leopard tail emerges anatomically from lower back, hangs behind legs and curves gently to viewer-right, whole tip visible without coiling like a snake.
Composition: full figure nearly straight front, head level, shoulders square, one foot slightly relaxed, dignified upright posture. Complete ears, head, tail, both trouser legs and both shoes fully in frame with margin. Vertical 2:3 studio portrait, neutral warm grey backdrop and believable floor contact shadows. No extra props, no chair, no stock graphics, no cigar, no weapon, no medals or corporate logo.
Style: high-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved short layered fur, delicate whiskers, natural muzzle microtexture, crisp fine wool weave and pinstripes, restrained silk tie sheen, distinct aged gold chain and smooth polished leather. Soft warm key with subtle cool fill, readable dark fabric and facial planes, natural crisp detail, controlled highlights. No plastic toy, no anime outlines, no flat painting, no excessive bloom, no oversharpening, no collage. One independent image, no text or watermark.
